page_title: ACM 5-1 CAG | AC Milan v Cagliari 11/05/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+3' That's the end of the match.
90+2' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Cagliari.
90' We will have 3 min. of added time.

89' Gianluca Lapadula (Cagliari) picks up a lofted cross inside the box and fires a quick shot to the middle of the goal. His promising effort is kept out by Marco Sportiello, who pulls off a stunning save!
88' Claudio Ranieri has decided to make a change. Mateusz Wieteska (Cagliari) replaces Yerry Mina.
86' 5 - 1 Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) connects with a pass inside the box and slams home low into the middle of the net. The goalkeeper was helpless.
84' Substitution. Tommaso Pobega (AC Milan) has come on for Ismael Bennacer.
83' 4 - 1 Ismael Bennacer passes to Rafael Leao (AC Milan), who gets one-on-one with the keeper. His dummy grounds the keeper and he has a simple task lifting the ball over him into the net.
82' Here is a change. Eldor Shomurodov is going off and Claudio Ranieri gives the last tactical orders to Kingstone Mutandwa (Cagliari).

80' Eldor Shomurodov (Cagliari) makes himself some space after collecting the corner kick and produces a close-range effort towards the roof of the net, but one of the opposition players deflects the ball onto the crossbar!
80' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Cagliari will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
76' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Gaetano Oristanio (Cagliari) will replace Alessandro Deiola.
76' Substitution. Nahitan Nandez will be replaced by Gianluca Lapadula (Cagliari).
76' Claudio Ranieri has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Paulo Daniel Dentello Azzi (Cagliari) replacing Alberto Dossena.

74' 3 - 1 What a beautiful moment! Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) got to the ball and unleashed a strong shot from distance. It turned out to be a good decision as his effort found its way into the bottom left corner. Simone Scuffet just shakes his head in disbelief. The score changes to 3:1.
73' The corner is swung in but AC Milan can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
69' Simone Sozza shows the yellow card to Yerry Mina (Cagliari) for a heavy challenge.
68' That will be all from Alessandro Florenzi who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Theo Hernandez (AC Milan).
63' 2 - 1 Nahitan Nandez (Cagliari) received a delightful pass inside the box before slotting the ball past the goalkeeper. What a brilliant finish!
59' 2 - 0 Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) finds himself one-on-one with the keeper after a great pass by Rafael Leao. He takes the shot early and scores!
57' Cagliari failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
55' Flag goes up against Nahitan Nandez (Cagliari) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
55' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Simone Scuffet, who smothers the ball.
52' Great teamplay by AC Milan as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
49' OFF THE BAR! Rafael Leao (AC Milan) receives a lofted pass from the side and shoots from around the penalty spot, but the ball crashes against the crossbar.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Stefano Pioli probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Olivier Giroud. He is replaced by Noah Okafor (AC Milan).
46' Stefano Pioli has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Rafael Leao comes on the pitch for Samuel Chukwueze (AC Milan).
46' Half-time substitution. Stefano Pioli decided to make a change. Matteo Gabbia (AC Milan) is replaced by Fikayo Tomori.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+1' Matteo Prati (Cagliari) receives a pass inside the box, controls the ball and drills it towards the left post. Unfortunately for him, Marco Sportiello makes a great save to stop his effort.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
41' Ismael Bennacer (AC Milan) gets in a good position to shoot just outside the box after a nice pass, but his effort is unintentionally blocked by one of his teammate.
40' Alessandro Florenzi (AC Milan) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
35' 1 - 0 Goal! Ismael Bennacer (AC Milan) slots the ball into an unguarded net from close range after a shot rebounds off a defender. 1:0.
35' Samuel Chukwueze (AC Milan) takes a good first touch from the pass, but mishits his shot low towards the middle of the goal and allows the Simone Scuffet to make a comfortable save.
33' Alessandro Deiola (Cagliari) is penalised after knocking an opponent down.
33' Matteo Gabbia (AC Milan) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Simone Sozza didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
28' The foul by Ismael Bennacer (AC Milan) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Simone Sozza.
24' Yunus Musah (AC Milan) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
23' Pierre Kalulu (AC Milan) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.

20' Nahitan Nandez (Cagliari) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety.
19' Matteo Gabbia (AC Milan) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle.
18' It looks like Ismael Bennacer (AC Milan) saw red with that tackle. Simone Sozza won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
16' The resulting corner from Alessandro Florenzi (AC Milan) is cleared.
13' Alessandro Florenzi (AC Milan) strikes the ball from the resulting free kick from the edge of the box, but his effort goes high over the bar.
12' Ibrahim Sulemana (Cagliari) is penalised for holding. Simone Sozza signals a set piece. It's a free kick to AC Milan, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
9' Alessandro Florenzi (AC Milan) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
8' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from AC Milan.
5' Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
3' Alessandro Florenzi (AC Milan) takes the corner with a short pass.

3' Alessandro Florenzi (AC Milan) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear. The referee blows his whistle, AC Milan are awarded a corner kick.
1' The first half has started.
The players are on the pitch and AC Milan will have the kick-off.
Simone Sozza is the one to supervise the game today.
Show lineups Both teams starting lineups are available now, so you can have a look at them.
